reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Tennessee
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Secondary methods of service (usable if primary is unsuccessful):
    Is delivery by commercial carrier a permitted secondary method of service
    for an eviction action?

    Statute encoded: TN Code  29-18-115 (2021)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation (TN Code  29-18-115 (2021))
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  We model "methods of service" authorized for eviction actions commenced under
  this chapter. The statute specifies several authorized methods (some are
  plainly fallbacks after failure of personal service attempts).

  We also model "secondary methods" as those that the statute allows only after
  some failure/dispensing condition (i.e., after the primary approach is
  unsuccessful), consistent with the question's definition of "secondary".
*/

% statute_authorized_method(+ActionType, +Method).
% TN Code  29-18-115 (2021) - authorized methods include:
statute_authorized_method(eviction_action, service_on_adult_in_possession).            % 29-18-115(a)
statute_authorized_method(eviction_action, service_on_contractually_named_party).     % 29-18-115(b)
statute_authorized_method(eviction_action, certified_mail_return_receipt_via_sheriff).% 29-18-115(c)
statute_authorized_method(eviction_action, personal_service_named_defendant).         % 29-18-115(e)(1)
statute_authorized_method(eviction_action, post_and_first_class_mail_after_3_attempts). % 29-18-115(e)(2)
statute_authorized_method(eviction_action, publication_plus_posting_notice).          % 29-18-115(a)(2) + (a)(1) cases via 21-1-203-21-1-205

% statute_primary_method(+ActionType, +Method).
% We treat the most direct/personal methods as "primary" for purposes of the question.
statute_primary_method(eviction_action, service_on_adult_in_possession).   % 29-18-115(a)
statute_primary_method(eviction_action, personal_service_named_defendant). % 29-18-115(e)(1)

% statute_secondary_method(+ActionType, +Method).
% Secondary methods = methods the statute makes available after primary service
% cannot be achieved (or is dispensed with / after multiple failed attempts).
statute_secondary_method(eviction_action, publication_plus_posting_notice).             % 29-18-115(a)(2) for 29-18-115(a)(1) cases
statute_secondary_method(eviction_action, post_and_first_class_mail_after_3_attempts).  % 29-18-115(e)(2)
statute_secondary_method(eviction_action, certified_mail_return_receipt_via_sheriff).   % 29-18-115(c) ("in lieu of subsection (a)")

% statute_mentions_commercial_carrier(+ActionType).
% There is no commercial-carrier option in 29-18-115; only USPS first class/certified.
statute_mentions_commercial_carrier(_ActionType) :-
    fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario translation (facts from the question)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state(tennessee).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The underlying proceeding is an eviction action.
scenario_action_type(eviction_action).

% The question frames "secondary methods" as those usable if the primary method is unsuccessful.
scenario_primary_unsuccessful.

% Proposed secondary method being asked about:
scenario_proposed_secondary_method(commercial_carrier_delivery).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the scenario facts (as encoded) hold.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(tennessee),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action_type(eviction_action),
    scenario_primary_unsuccessful,
    scenario_proposed_secondary_method(commercial_carrier_delivery).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning helpers
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% requested_secondary_method_in_scenario(-Method).
requested_secondary_method_in_scenario(Method) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_primary_unsuccessful,
    scenario_proposed_secondary_method(Method).

% permitted_secondary_method_for_eviction(+Method).
permitted_secondary_method_for_eviction(Method) :-
    statute_secondary_method(eviction_action, Method),
    statute_authorized_method(eviction_action, Method).

% commercial_carrier_is_permitted_secondary_method_for_eviction/0.
commercial_carrier_is_permitted_secondary_method_for_eviction :-
    permitted_secondary_method_for_eviction(commercial_carrier_delivery).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% housing_answer/1 (must be deterministic; Result = yes or no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    requested_secondary_method_in_scenario(commercial_carrier_delivery),
    commercial_carrier_is_permitted_secondary_method_for_eviction,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    requested_secondary_method_in_scenario(commercial_carrier_delivery),
    \+ commercial_carrier_is_permitted_secondary_method_for_eviction,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful. Is delivery by commercial carrier a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
